I have implemented the `encryption` package and integrated streaming AES-256-GCM encryption across `config`, `fileutil`, `storage`, and `handler` on the `feat/encryption` branch:

- **Encryption Stream & Key Management** ([encryption.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-zwxfzuc7/encryption/encryption.go), [config.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-zwxfzuc7/encryption/config.go), [encryption_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-zwxfzuc7/encryption/encryption_test.go)):
  - [`NewEncryptor`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-zwxfzuc7/encryption/encryption.go#L35-L42) validates 32-byte keys (wrapping [`ErrInvalidKey`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-zwxfzuc7/encryption/encryption.go#L29)) and [`Encryptor.EncryptWriter`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-zwxfzuc7/encryption/encryption.go#L44-L56) streams up to 64KB AES-256-GCM chunks prefixed with the `0x4F 0x44 0x01` header and terminated by a 4-byte zero sentinel + 32-byte HMAC-SHA256 trailer, with idempotent `Close()`.
  - [`DecryptReader`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-zwxfzuc7/encryption/encryption.go#L179-L200) lazily initializes on `Read`, verifying magic bytes, version `0x01`, chunk authentication, truncation, and HMAC integrity.
  - [`Config`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-zwxfzuc7/encryption/config.go#L25-L33), [`Config.Validate`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-zwxfzuc7/encryption/config.go#L75-L80), and [`LoadKey`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-zwxfzuc7/encryption/config.go#L133-L202) support case-insensitive `env`, `file`, `literal`, and `derive` key sources with mutual-exclusivity checks.
- **Job Config & File Suffixes** ([job.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-zwxfzuc7/config/job.go), [filenutil.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-zwxfzuc7/fileutil/filenutil.go), [storage.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-zwxfzuc7/storage/storage.go)):
  - Added `Encryption` to [`config.Job`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-zwxfzuc7/config/job.go#L49-L68), [`Job.Encrypted`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-zwxfzuc7/config/job.go#L136-L138), and exported [`Job.Validate`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-zwxfzuc7/config/job.go#L113-L130).

- **Handler Pipeline** ([jobhandler.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-zwxfzuc7/handler/jobhandler.go), [jobhandler_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-zwxfzuc7/handler/jobhandler_test.go)):
